page.overview:
Who is Shrithek Al'lya?

Shrithek Al'lya was a Bothan male bureaucrat of Clan Alya who held the position of Consul of Natural Resources on the Bothan Colonial Board on the Bothan colony world of Kothlis.

Al'lya had a business entrepreneur background, and, being typical for a Bothan politician, he was corrupt, using his position for personal gain. His business interests remained active during his term, he could take advantange of regulations to hamper competing businesses and favor those he had interest in.

Al'lya possessed a precious ganjuko-carved knife.
